svg.text: Soft cairn (a pear: belly low, head leaning back)
64 W x 60 D x 110 H mm (lid included); flat foot 46 x 44; shell ~46 cm3, ~154 g with board 30 g + battery 55 g (assumed)
centre of mass 23 behind the foot's front edge, 48 up; tips at ~23° back / 25° forward (worst direction 23°); tilt15: 22 / 29, oval: 18 / 17
#13 at true size. Belly 64 wide and 62 deep at z 18; above z 60 it slims to 52 x 30 and the back leans 6° the same way as the face, so the head nods back over the waist;
soft top (R12). Front as the pebble: straight along the lean over the slots, bowed across the width. Same underside: first 45° of the round in the lid, the rest in the shell.
1 mm = 4 px, grid 10 mm. Blue-grey: stack box s 12..95 (along the face from the rim), t 3..26; dashed in it: real board+glass and battery. Blue: rods 8 x 66.65 at x ±10.23. Red: CoM, flat foot.
